name: Galleria
description: Galleria is a modern, self-hosted photography portfolio platform built with React, TypeScript, and Express. Features include image optimization, album management, analytics, Google OAuth authentication, AI title generation (optional), MFA/Passkey support, and a beautiful responsive UI. Perfect for photographers who want full control over their portfolio without monthly fees.
